title: Shape Surprise Studio
shareTitle: Shape Surprise Studio — Paper Shapes Become Pictures
description: Tap, stretch, and fit colorful paper shapes to reveal kittens, rockets, sunny faces, sailboats, and more in a tactile papercraft garden.
learningGoals: Recognize circles, squares, rectangles, ovals, and triangles
Imagine a whole picture growing from one simple shape
Compose familiar pictures from shape parts using direct touch
interactionModel: three image-led modes: tap or trace a shape, pinch or slide to grow it, and drag or tap-tap paper pieces into matching ghosts
feedbackModel: Paper shapes lift, wiggle, snap, and transform into authored surprise art with synthesized sparkle sounds, gentle retries, idle hints, and recorded teacher narration.

modes.title: Tap Magic
modes.skill: notice a simple shape becoming a complete picture

modes.title: Stretch Magic
modes.skill: connect shape growth with a new visual idea

modes.title: Picture Builder
modes.skill: compose a whole picture from geometric parts
